Signed-in fixtures render actual component/hooks with original source CSS, isolated reads/thread/report services, code-native QA photos and stub header/navigation. No live Firebase writes, device location, real moderation, consent-flow or signed-in E2E claim. Farmer content is unchanged and marked unknown-language. No PLAN_VERSION change or production merge.
